paper_identity.title: Giant Pairing Vibrations in light nuclei

theoretical_benchmark.title: Two particle transfer reactions: the search for the Giant Pairing Vibration

cross_mass_significance: Resolves the cross-mass transferability failure of the Giant Pairing Vibration (GPV): explains why GPV is cleanly observed in light nuclei (14C, 15C) via heavy-ion (18O,16O) transfer but completely obscured in heavy nuclei (208Pb, 120Sn) under standard (p,t) probes due to kinematic Q-mismatch and QPVC continuum damping.
